title: Power BI Developer Pleno
description:
Sobre a empresa

A Digital Launch é uma consultoria de Business Intelligence e AI sediada em Brasília. Atuamos com projetos de dados ponta a ponta para clientes do Brasil e dos EUA, transformando dados em decisões com entregas rápidas, confiáveis e escaláveis.

Nossa especialidade está no ecossistema Microsoft, com Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, SQL, SSAS. Modelagem tabular e boas práticas de arquitetura analítica. Também apoiamos iniciativas de automação e soluções com AI, sempre com foco em impacto real no negócio.

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Power BI Developer Pleno com perfil mão na massa para atuar como braço direito em nossos clientes. Você vai apoiar demandas de alto nível em três frentes: Arquitetura de BI, Analytics Engineering e desenvolvimento avançado em Power BI.

Vaga 100% presencial em Brasília. Contrato PJ. Inglês intermediário a avançado.

Responsabilidades :

  • Construir e evoluir relatórios e dashboards no Power BI com foco em performance e clareza
  • Criar e otimizar medidas DAX. Time intelligence, ranking, variações, KPIs, contextos de filtro
  • Modelar dados com boas práticas. Esquema estrela, granularidade, relacionamentos, RLS quando necessário
  • Trabalhar com SQL forte para análise, extração e troubleshooting. Queries complexas, CTE, window functions, performance
  • Atuar com Microsoft Fabric quando aplicável. Lakehouse, pipelines, dataflows gen2, semantic models, boas práticas de camada e governança
  • Apoiar atividades relacionadas a SSAS Tabular. Analysis Services e modelagem tabular quando necessário
  • Investigar erros e inconsistências. Refresh, gateway, qualidade de dados, performance do modelo
  • Documentar o que foi feito e manter organização de entregas. Checklist, padrões, versionamento quando aplicável
  • Fazer interface objetiva com demandas. Entender o pedido, fazer as perguntas certas, devolver solução pronta

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com Power BI Desktop e Power BI Service
  • DAX forte. CALCULATE, FILTER, ALL, ALLSELECTED, SUMX, RANKX, time intelligence
  • SQL forte. Leitura e escrita com segurança, debug e otimização
  • Modelagem de dados muito bem fundamentada
  • Conhecimento prático de Microsoft Fabric ou disposição para atuar diariamente com Fabric
  • Experiência com SSAS Tabular. Analysis Services e modelagem tabular é diferencial forte
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado para lidar com materiais, tickets, reuniões pontuais e clientes dos EUA
  • Perfil organizado, confiável e com autonomia. Capaz de tocar tarefas com pouca supervisão

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com governança e boas práticas em modelos semânticos. Performance tuning e incremental refresh
  • Experiência com Git e processos de deploy
  • Experiência em projetos com clientes internacionais e comunicação assíncrona bem escrita

Como se candidatar :

  • Envie currículo e, se possível, portfólio. Pode ser prints, descrição de projetos, GitHub, PBIX sem dados sensíveis, ou posts técnicos. Inclua disponibilidade e pretensão PJ.

title: Gerente de loja
description:
Descrição da posição

Responsável pela gestão estratégica e operacional da loja, com foco em performance de vendas, rentabilidade, execução de processos, desenvolvimento de lideranças e mitigação de riscos, garantindo o cumprimento das metas e padrões estabelecidos pela companhia.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Analisar indicadores de desempenho (vendas, DRE, orçamento, estoque e produtos financeiros), identificando oportunidades e definindo planos de ação para melhoria de resultados.
  • Liderar, orientar e desenvolver supervisores e líderes, assegurando a padronização dos processos operacionais, comerciais e de atendimento.
  • Atuar diretamente na alavancagem de vendas e produtos financeiros, com foco em reversão de performance e atingimento de metas.
  • Monitorar indicadores de prevenção de perdas, avaliando ocorrências e reportando à gestão corporativa.
  • Supervisionar processos de caixa e numerários, garantindo conformidade, controles internos e integridade das informações.
  • Acompanhar o mercado e a concorrência, identificando oportunidades de diferenciação e ganho competitivo.
  • Conduzir processos de seleção, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, em parceria com a gestão regional.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em varejo com atuação em cargos de liderança;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de indicadores e em processos operacionais.
  • Pacote Office intermediário.

O que a empresa oferece

  • Pacote de benefícios competitivo com o mercado;
  • Programas estruturados de desenvolvimento e carreira;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, com forte orientação a resultados e pessoas.

title: Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
Atividades:

Desenvolver soluções backend robustas, escaláveis e seguras (preferencialmente em Go), atuando no coração da nossa plataforma.

Participar da evolução da arquitetura dos nossos serviços, propondo melhorias e trazendo visão de longo prazo.

Colaborar ativamente na construção de processos técnicos, padrões, boas práticas e automações.

Investigar problemas complexos, propor soluções inteligentes e antecipar riscos e impactos.

Trabalhar lado a lado com Produto, Design e demais áreas para entregar soluções de alto impacto para médicos, pacientes e parceiros.

Garantir qualidade nas entregas, com testes, documentação e preocupação com performance.

Contribuir com ideias, discussões técnicas e revisões de código, elevando o nível técnico do time.

Apoiar a cultura de engenharia com práticas modernas (CI/CD, observabilidade, segurança, escalabilidade).

Aqui você terá autonomia, espaço para construir e liberdade para experimentar. É uma vaga para quem gosta de deixar legado técnico.

Requisitos da vaga:

Cloud & Infraestrutura

Experiência com AWS e boa compreensão de ambientes escaláveis, seguros e de alta disponibilidade.

Vivência com Kubernetes, API Gateway e monitoramento/observabilidade.

Desenvolvimento Backend

Forte conhecimento em Go (ou abertura para aprender rapidamente).

Experiência em criação e manutenção de APIs performáticas e resilientes.

Bancos de Dados

SQL sólido, principalmente em MySQL e/ou PostgreSQL.

Capacidade de modelagem, otimização e entendimento de desempenho.

Arquitetura & Escalabilidade

Experiência com microsserviços, mensageria, event-driven e integrações complexas.

Entendimento sobre escalabilidade horizontal/vertical, HA, tolerância a falhas e boas práticas de arquitetura.

Containers

Uso de Docker no dia a dia para criação de ambientes consistentes.

Mensageria e Eventos

Familiaridade com SQS, Kafka ou similares.

Entendimento de sync vs async, consistência e padrões de comunicação.

Segurança

Conhecimento de OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT e boas práticas de segurança em APIs.

Desejável:

Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos, com múltiplos produtos e frentes de trabalho simultâneas, onde o contexto pode mudar rapidamente e é necessário gerenciar prioridades de forma estratégica e adaptável.

Experiência no setor de saúde ou em ambientes regulados (healthtechs, pharma, planos de saúde, fintechs, etc.).

Conhecimento sobre o ecossistema de saúde brasileiro, prescrições digitais, prontuário eletrônico ou jornada de pacientes e médicos.

Vivência com produtos de mídia digital, marketplaces ou plataformas B2B2C.

Experiência com monetização de produtos digitais, modelos de negócio baseados em dados ou publicidade.

title: Analista Jurídico Júnior /Vaga exclusiva para Pessoa com Deficiência
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Genial Investimentos é uma das maiores plataformas de investimentos do Brasil. Com mais de 2 milhões de clientes, estamos presentes em todo o país por meio de nossos escritórios e assessores parceiros.

Nascemos com um propósito claro: democratizar o acesso ao mercado financeiro , oferecendo produtos, serviços e tecnologia de ponta para todos os perfis de investidor — do iniciante ao profissional.

title: Supervisor de Vendas - Loja na Zona Sul de São Paulo
description:
Embora o carro tenha um papel fundamental na vida de muitas pessoas, só 25% da população da América Latina consegue ter acesso a ele. E foi por isso que a Kovi nasceu: para mudar essa estatística!

Acreditamos que todas as pessoas merecem ter a oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas e, em busca desse propósito, trabalhamos todos os dias para criar soluções de mobilidade acessíveis, flexíveis e simples.

Hoje, já oferecemos planos de aluguel no inédito modelo “pague o que usar”, compra de carros sem análise de crédito e seguro auto com contratação simplificada. E queremos continuar promovendo a inclusão, através da eficiência e inovação!

O desafio é grande, mas nossa vontade de fazer a diferença é ainda maior! E estamos buscando pessoas incríveis para fazer parte dessa revolução. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e de aprendizado constante. #VemSerKover!

Time Kovi:

Ser Kover é sinônimo de ser super engajado quando o assunto é desafio. Amamos pessoas que se importam com outras pessoas, que tenham brilho nos olhos e vontade de sobra para mudar o mundo. Se você acredita em um mundo onde todos tenham oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas, vem ser #Kover! ♥

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Supervisionar diretamente a equipe de consultores de vendas, garantindo a execução do processo comercial com disciplina e foco em resultados;
  • Acompanhar os principais KPIs de atividade e performance (atendimentos/dia, follow-ups, taxa de conversão, tempo de resposta, entre outros), promovendo correções de rota sempre que necessário;
  • Conduzir rituais de gestão com consistência, como reuniões diárias de alinhamento, 1:1 semanais, feedbacks estruturados e planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDI);
  • Monitorar a aderência da equipe às rotinas e boas práticas definidas, garantindo qualidade no atendimento e correta utilização do CRM;
  • Atuar como facilitador do desenvolvimento do time, identificando gaps técnicos ou comportamentais e apoiando com treinamentos direcionados ou coaching;
  • Participar ativamente da construção de campanhas, metas e estratégias comerciais, trazendo a visão da operação para decisões táticas;
  • Garantir o cumprimento da jornada de trabalho, escala de atendimento e cobertura da operação em todos os turnos;
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima à gerência, fornecendo insumos de performance, evolução do time e sugestões para melhoria contínua da operação.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência prévia com liderança de equipes de vendas ou operações comerciais, especialmente em ambientes de alta demanda e ritmo acelerado;
  • Domínio de técnicas de venda consultiva, gestão de funil e controle de indicadores de desempenho (atividade, conversão, qualidade e resultado);
  • Experiência no uso de CRM (como HubSpot, Salesforce ou similares) e ferramentas de monitoramento de produtividade;
  • Capacidade de estruturar e acompanhar rituais de gestão: 1:1, feedbacks recorrentes, reuniões de time e PDIs;
  • Forte habilidade analítica para interpretar dados e tomar decisões com base em KPIs (conhecimento em Excel/Google Sheets é essencial; Power BI e SQL são diferenciais);
  • Ensino superior completo em áreas correlatas (Administração, Gestão Comercial, Engenharia, Economia ou similares);
  • Desejável experiência ou formação complementar em liderança, gestão de equipes ou desenvolvimento humano;
  • Perfil "mão na massa", com alto senso de responsabilidade e foco em entrega de resultado;
  • Proatividade na identificação de problemas e implementação de melhorias operacionais;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa e habilidade para engajar e desenvolver pessoas;
  • Organização e disciplina na execução dos processos comerciais;
  • Resiliência para lidar com pressão e habilidade para manter o time motivado em contextos desafiadores;
  • Espírito colaborativo e visão sistêmica, com capacidade de transitar entre diferentes áreas e níveis da organização.

Informações adicionais

O que você vai encontrar aqui:

Seguro de Vida: Para cuidarmos do nosso bem maior: nossos Kovers.

Plano de Saúde: É importante se cuidar e estar bem.

Plano Odontológico: Para você dar aquele sorrisão bonito!

Cartão Flash: Seu VR e/ou VA em um único cartão! Até porque como diz o ditado: “saco vazio não para em pé!”

Vale-Transporte ou Vale-Combustível: A escolha de como você se move é só sua.

Pai, mãe e filhos: Auxílio creche, licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e licença paternidade estendida de 20 dias.

Wellhub: Todos os Kovers têm direito a se exercitar com parte do valor subsidiado pela Kovi.

Kovenção: A reunião que a liderança da Kovi tem com a empresa inteira para que todos fiquem por dentro do status do negócio.

title: Estagiário de direito

Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 1932 e, desde então, acumulamos vasta experiência na prestação de assessoria jurídica a clientes nacionais e internacionais.

Somos um escritório de advocacia full service especializado nos setores de infra-estrutura, comércio e logística com destaque em direito marítimo, portos e infraestrutura, energia, óleo e gás, ambiental, ferroviário e setor público com foco em contencioso e arbitragem, tributário e aduaneiro, societário, regulatório, contratual, trabalhista e compliance,

No Kincaid respeitamos as individualidades e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferenças.

Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso!

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Analista da Qualidade
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista da Qualidade para atuar junto à área de produção, garantindo excelência nos processos que envolvem a fabricação de equipamentos aviônicos. Essa posição é estratégica para assegurar padrões de qualidade, liderar análises críticas e promover melhorias contínuas. Se você tem perfil colaborativo, gosta de trabalhar com diferentes áreas e possui inglês fluente, essa oportunidade é para você!

Nessa posição você terá o desafio de

  • Realizar análises periódicas dos principais detratores do processo produtivo e conduzir ações para solucioná-los;
  • Liderar times de solução de problemas e conduzir análises de causa-raiz;
  • Planejar e liderar PFMEAs, gerando planos de controle e identificando características-chave;
  • Implantar CEP (Controle Estatístico de Processo) quando apropriado;
  • Planejar e realizar auditorias de processo e produto;
  • Conduzir treinamentos para equipes de produção e qualidade;
  • Participar de fóruns mensais (QA Forum) e liderar melhorias de processos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em processos produtivos e metodologias de melhoria contínua;
  • Conhecimento em APQP, PFMEA, planos de controle, CEP, 6 Sigma e auditorias de processo;
  • Inglês fluente (contato com matriz e auditorias internacionais);
  • Habilidade para liderar times multifuncionais e conduzir análises de causa-raiz;
  • Boa comunicação, perfil proativo e capacidade de influenciar diferentes áreas;
  • Diferencial: experiência com produção de placas eletrônicas e treinamentos.

O que a AEL te proporciona

  • Política de horários flexível e modelo híbrido: Atuamos com banco de horas e possibilidade de alguns dias de atuação remota, proporcionando uma rotina flexível
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed: Custos de adesão subsidiados pela AEL
  • Seguro de Vida: Zelamos pela sua proteção e de seus familiares
  • Vale Alimentação e Refeitório: Utilizamos o cartão multibenefícios Flash e contamos com refeitório na empresa
  • Auxílio Mobilidade/Vale Transporte: Facilitamos o seu deslocamento diário com opções que se adaptam à sua rotina
  • Estimulamos o equilíbrio da vida pessoal e profissional: Temos um calendário anual de feriados e férias coletivas, visando estimular o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional
  • Celebramos nossas conquistas: temos diversas ações de confraternização e reconhecimento, celebrando os atingimentos da jornada
  • Auxílio idioma: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento através do aprimoramento em inglês
  • Prêmio de fim de ano: Reconhecemos os desafios atingidos ao fim do ano
  • Incentivos à prática de atividades físicas: Investimos na sua saúde através de grupos de corrida, ginástica funcional e ginástica laboral
  • Bebê AEL: Celebramos a chegada de novos membros das famílias
  • Empresa Cidadã: Contamos com dias estendidos de licença maternidade e paternidade

Sobre a AEL Sistemas

Excelência faz parte da nossa cultura. Está em tudo o que fazemos, nos processos, na forma de ser e inovar. A cada dia, o nosso potencial criativo se materializa na tecnologia de ponta que desenvolvemos. Aqui valorizamos as relações humanas, amigáveis e plurais, identificando os momentos em que é preciso seguir a formalidade e reforçar a nossa experiência.

Somos uma empresa genuinamente brasileira. Desde 2001 fazemos parte de um dos maiores conglomerados de defesa mundial: o Grupo Elbit Systems. E isso nos torna únicos: temos uma essência local, com presença e tecnologia global.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Produção Sênior - Melhoria Contínua

Sobre a Oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Produção Sênior para atuar com Melhoria Contínua em ambiente de mineração . A posição terá papel estratégico na identificação, análise e implementação de projetos de melhoria contínua , contribuindo diretamente para ganhos de eficiência operacional, redução de custos, aumento de produtividade e melhoria dos indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) .

O(a) profissional atuará de forma transversal , apoiando a padronização de processos , a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e a disseminação da cultura de melhoria contínua , com atuação prática nos processos de mina . Esperamos um perfil analítico , organizado e orientado a indicadores , excelente relacionamento interpessoal , capacidade de influenciar mudanças e boa comunicação para disseminar metodologias e desenvolver pessoas .

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir projetos de melhoria contínua nos processos de mineração subterrânea, com foco em eficiência operacional, produtividade, custos e segurança;
  • Aplicar metodologias como Lean e Six Sigma na padronização e otimização dos processos de lavra e desenvolvimento de mina;
  • Analisar e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), apoiando a tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Atuar de forma transversal com as áreas de operação, manutenção, planejamento, geologia e segurança;
  • Disseminar a cultura de melhoria contínua, apoiando a gestão da mudança e a capacitação das equipes;
  • Conduzir treinamentos e workshops sobre metodologias de melhoria contínua, padronização de processos e boas práticas operacionais;
  • Garantir que as iniciativas de melhoria estejam em conformidade com os requisitos de SSMA, qualidade e compliance;
  • Mapear, padronizar e revisar processos operacionais subterrâneos, assegurando a sustentabilidade das melhorias e a aderência aos padrões operacionais.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação Superior Completa em Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em projetos de melhoria contínua aplicados ao ambiente de mineração;
  • Experiência em análise de dados, gestão de custos e acompanhamento de indicadores (KPIs);
  • Domínio de metodologias de melhoria contínua;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura e escrita);
  • Certificação Green Belt ou Black Belt (desejável).

title: HR Manager
description:
Human Resources Manager

Manage activities of departments or personnel services, recruitment and selection, positions and salaries, benefits, training and development, leading and facilitating the development of team work; advise the company's board of directors and sectors on activities such as planning, hiring, human relations and labor negotiations; They perform at corporate and community events, representing the company.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage activities related to Human Resources, involving Training & Development, Position & Salary management, Benefits Administration, Personnel Administration and Payroll, Recruitment & Selection, Medicine and Occupational Health, Internal Communication, Labor Relations and Union Relations .
  • Monitor the development of activities in the area, through reports, meetings and office examinations, evaluating results and identifying deviations in relation to work programs and quality levels, as well as possible causes, taking corrective measures or seeking alternative solutions, aiming to enable the effectiveness of services.
  • Provide assistance to the Board in the preparation and implementation of the company's strategic plan, participating in meetings, providing information related to legislation, guidelines, standards, procedures and perspectives inherent to the Human Resources area, both nationally and internationally, in order to assist them in carrying out the work.
  • Manage the area's activities with a sense of effective results, innovation, continuous improvement and preventive action, in line with company guidelines.
  • Manage human resources allocated in your area, evaluating and/or analyzing individual performance results, defining and providing guidance on training and professional development actions, requesting functional and salary changes, proposing admissions and dismissals, authorizing transfers, applying disciplinary measures and keeping them informed about the company's policies, rules and regulations, aiming to integrate the organization and enhance staff value.
  • Assess the need for changes to the section's work methodology and procedure routine, based on activity reports and operational results, analyzing, with the support of specialized areas, existing deficiencies and aspects to be rationalized, formalizing them, obtaining, if necessary, , superior approval and implementing them, aiming to optimize the systems.
  • Define the human and material resources that will be included in the plant's budget forecast, depending on the established programs, analyzing the need to acquire furniture and equipment, sizing personnel and administrative expenses, providing guidance on filling out the appropriate documentation, signing and submitting to the superior approval, in order to support the company's economic and financial programming.
  • Discuss with interface areas and immediate superior the resulting technical, administrative and/or financial aspects and ways of adapting activities to the operational capacity of the section, resizing the workload, redefining strategies, guidelines and action plans, aiming to optimize results .
  • Keep up to date to support area management with sensitive information about policies, actions and procedures related to Human Resources management in a national and international environment.
  • Provide training for company leaders on best practices for human and team development and work to promote an integrated organizational climate, through the development, implementation and monitoring of programs to improve internal/interpersonal communications.
  • Participate in weekly meetings with the Plant's management body (PBU staff), discussing matters of interest, presenting suggestions, defining action programs to address problems and shortcomings detected, aligning guidelines and strategies for the execution/monitoring and evaluation of manufacturing projects, among others topics of interest, in order to comply with established guidelines, as well as participate in the Organization's decision-making.
  • Manage union relations activities, including annual plant negotiations, such as: base date and PRE.
  • Maintain close relationships with union representatives. Monitor direct and indirect inspections and legal proceedings.
  • Define strategies for talent retention, including reviewing salaries and benefits applicable to each position.
  • Comply with the annual performance review calendar for talent management.
  • Perform other tasks relevant to the role.

Requirements:

  • Postgraduate degree in Human Resources, People Management or related areas.
  • Advanced English
  • 7-8 years of experience in similar position.
  • Presentation techniques, negotiation techniques and labor legislation (desirable)

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with 30 years of experience, is seeking a Salesforce OEM Application Developer to support a US-based customer. This position collaborates with development teams in the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, focusing on designing, developing, and maintaining a managed Salesforce OEM application.

This role is ideal for someone with deep Salesforce development expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in English.

About the Role:

As a Salesforce OEM Application Developer, you will work closely with product managers, clients, and internal teams to gather and refine technical requirements, translate business needs into robust application features, and maintain a secure, scalable Salesforce OEM solution. You will develop advanced functionality combining code and configuration, manage integrations and data migrations, troubleshoot application-level issues, and support packaging, versioning, and upgrades of the managed application.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain a managed Salesforce OEM application using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools.
  • Build advanced Salesforce functionality, including complex Flows, triggers, asynchronous processing, and Community/Experience Cloud implementations .
  • Architect scalable and secure solutions aligned with Salesforce OEM/ISV best practices , including multi-tenant considerations and upgrade-safe design.
  • Develop and maintain custom data models, integrations, and automation , ensuring performance, governor-limit compliance, and maintainability.
  • Manage data migration and transformation processes using Apex, ETL tools, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application-level issues including Apex logic, automation conflicts, and deployment errors.
  • Build test classes with strong code coverage and participate in CI/CD and release management activities.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation , including architecture workbooks, developer/admin guides, testing strategies, and deployment protocols.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators and customer technical teams to ensure correct configuration and extension of the OEM application.

Required Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience , including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Proven experience blending programmatic development and declarative configuration for scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Experience designing and implementing advanced Flows, triggers, and automation based on business rules.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, security, permissions, sharing models, and performance optimization .
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders to design sophisticated user experiences across screens, records, and automation processes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and modern release practices .
  • Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I/II, Administrator or Advanced Administrator (Platform App Builder preferred).
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with C# and the .NET ecosystem for backend services or integrations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows for code generation, testing, or documentation.
  • Prior experience building or supporting OEM/ISV applications , including managed packages, AppExchange distribution, or Salesforce Security Review preparation.
  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.

Sobre a Klabin

Na Klabin, acreditamos no poder da inclusão para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo e que o respeito às diferenças, conduta ética nos negócios e transparência nas relações são chaves para um ambiente de trabalho mais rico, inovador e que nos faz ir além.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

Obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Talent Data Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.

Key responsibilities:

- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.

Requirements:

- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- An understanding of top-of-the-line Data Analysis tools. Previous experience with administration, licensing, security, and deployment is a plus.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Salesforce Developer (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

title: Atendente de loja
description:
Vaga: Atendente de Loja – Bomboniere Resumo do cargo
A pessoa Atendente de Loja será responsável por oferecer um atendimento cordial e eficiente aos clientes da bomboniere, auxiliando na escolha de produtos, operando o caixa e contribuindo para a organização e boa apresentação do espaço. Este cargo é fundamental para garantir uma experiência positiva de compra e fortalecer o relacionamento com os clientes. Responsabilidades
  • Realizar atendimento ao cliente de forma cordial, respeitosa e inclusiva, esclarecendo dúvidas sobre produtos e preços.
  • Operar o caixa, efetuando registros de vendas, recebimentos e fechamento quando necessário, com atenção e responsabilidade.
  • Organizar e repor produtos nas prateleiras, mantendo a loja limpa, organizada e atrativa.
  • Conferir validade, conservação e exposição adequada dos produtos da bomboniere.

title: Data Platform Architect (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Data Platform Architect with 8+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing and building secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouses, and embedded analytics ecosystems.

The Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, implementing, and evolving the end-to-end data architecture that powers our platform analytics, reporting, and data automation ecosystem. This role will design a scalable, automated multi-tenant data warehouse and pipeline architecture that integrates hundreds of tenant schemas from our SaaS platform into a centralized, governed, and cost-optimized analytics environment (AWS-based: Redshift, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, QuickSight).The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering expertise with systems-level architecture—balancing automation, performance, and cost while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability for every customer.Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.

Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

  • Architect a multi-tenant data platform capable of ingesting 500+ tenant schemas with automated onboarding/offboarding workflows
  • Design an end-to-end architecture that includes data lakes, warehouses, transformation pipelines, and semantic layers
  • Define data zone strategy (Raw Staging Serving), partitioning, and schema evolution patterns
  • Establish standards for data contracts, metadata cataloging, and lineage tracking across all tenants
  • Drive selection and configuration of core technologies (e.g., Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation, dbt, Lambda, Airflow)
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps to ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) is applied to all data assets

Pipeline & Automation

  • Design metadata-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting incremental updates, schema drift, and tenant isolation
  • Ensure pipelines are idempotent, self-healing, and fully integrated into CI/CD processes
  • Partner with the Data Pipeline Engineers to deliver automated data onboarding, testing, and quality validation

Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Define workload management, clustering, and distribution strategies in Redshift or equivalent MPP systems
  • Implement data lifecycle management policies to optimize storage and compute costs
  • Continuously evaluate query performance, caching, and concurrency scaling options

Governance & Security

  • Implement data governance frameworks to ensure privacy, PII compliance, and secure tenant isolation
  • Partner with InfoSec to align encryption (KMS multi-region keys), object lock, and access control policies with SOC/PCI/GDPR standards
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems for data quality and operational stability

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure architecture aligns with business and product goals
  • Mentor engineers on modern data platform practices (dbt, ELT, IaC, observability)
  • Act as a technical authority and evangelist for data platform best practices within the organization

Required Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 3 years architecting cloud-native data platforms
  • Proven success in building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or Airflow
  • Expertise in Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent MPP databases, including workload management and query optimization
  • Proficiency with S3-based data lakes, Glue Data Catalog, and Lake Formation
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (Kimball/ELT) and multi-tenant system design
  • Experience defining and enforcing data governance frameworks (PII, access control, lineage)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data assets
  • Strong SQL and Python skills; dbt experience preferred

Desired Experience

description:

Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. Our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.

Who are You ?

You are relentlessly committed to delivering exceptional partner support, combining deep technical knowledge with sharp analytical skills to resolve issues efficiently and prevent them from recurring. You excel at interpreting data, logs, and system behavior to uncover root causes and provide clear, actionable insights to both partners and internal teams.

A confident and influential communicator, you build strong relationships with operators, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. You thrive on translating complex technical details into understandable guidance, ensuring that partners always feel supported and informed.

Where you Fit In:

We are seeking a proactive and technically strong B2B Technical Support Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will leverage your deep understanding of the iGaming industry and your strong analytical mindset to troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve issues reported by our operators and internal stakeholders.

Working closely with the ITSM department — and reporting directly to the Technical Support Team Lead — you will be a key player in ensuring high-quality, timely support. Your ability to interpret logs, analyze platform behavior, communicate clearly, and escalate effectively will help maintain platform reliability and deliver an exceptional partner experience.

You will thrive in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail, technical curiosity, and a commitment to service excellence are essential. Your work will be pivotal in strengthening partner trust, improving operational stability, and supporting our mission to deliver a seamless and compliant gaming experience worldwide.

The impact you will have:

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for B2B operators, platform partners, and integrators, ensuring their issues are resolved quickly, accurately, and with minimal business impact.
  • Perform in-depth technical troubleshooting across game integrations, wallet systems, API calls, transaction flows, and platform services — using logs, monitoring tools, and diagnostics to identify root causes.
  • Identify, flag, and track repetitive issues or recurring error patterns, escalating them with clear technical context to drive permanent fixes.
  • Ensure all partner interactions, escalations, and resolutions align with regulatory requirements, internal controls, and jurisdictional rules — maintaining strong compliance awareness at all times.
  • Coordinate cross-team escalations ensuring that complex issues are escalated and documented clearly and progressed efficiently.
  • Stay current with industry standards, emerging technologies, and best practices across iGaming, payments, and platform operations, recommending improvements to processes and tooling.
  • Champion adoption of shared support frameworks — authoring playbooks, SLA policies, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles to standardize excellence across the organization.

What we’re looking for:

  • Experience in B2B Technical Support within the Casino or iGaming sector.
  • Strong understanding of iGaming systems such as game aggregation, wallet services, RNG, bonus engines, player tracking, and jurisdictional compliance.
  • Experience working with logs, monitoring tools, and debugging complex integration issues.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases, partners, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills.
  • Hands-on experience with common support tooling (ex: Jira, Grafana, Kibana, etc.).

This role is remote and based in Brazil.

Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.

The Controller is a hands-on, strategic finance leader responsible for overseeing all accounting operations across the company. This role ensures accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, and scalable processes to support a growing, multi-brand food business.

The Controller partners closely with leadership to provide financial insights, manage cash flow, and support operational decision-making in a fast-moving CPG environment. This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable operating at both the transactional and strategic levels.

This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process for all entities
  • Prepare and review timely and accurate financial statements including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow
  • Ensure proper revenue recognition, inventory accounting, COGS, and accruals
  • Maintain and enforce consistent accounting policies and procedures
  • Manage the chart of accounts and general ledger structure to support brand-level and customer-level analysis

Inventory, Costing & Manufacturing Finance

  • Oversee inventory accounting for raw materials, work-in-process, and finished goods
  • Ensure accurate standard costing and variance analysis across materials, labor, and overhead
  • Partner with Operations to reconcile production, yields, and inventory movements
  • Drive accuracy and functionality of ERP systems, including Katana
  • Monitor and analyze margins by SKU, customer, and sales channel

Cash Flow, AP/AR & Controls

  • Manage cash flow forecasting and short- and medium-term liquidity planning
  • Oversee accounts payable and accounts receivable processes
  • Improve working capital efficiency including inventory turns, DSO, and DPO
  • Implement and maintain strong internal controls and approval workflows
  • Manage vendor payments, ACH and check processes, and banking relationships

Systems, Process & Scale

  • Own and optimize accounting systems and integrations including QuickBooks, ERP (Katana), and bill-pay tools
  • Improve automation, documentation, and repeatable finance processes
  • Prepare the finance function for audit readiness and future growth
  • Partner on system upgrades, implementations, and reporting enhancements

Compliance & External Relationships

  • Ensure compliance with GAAP and applicable tax and regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate with external CPA firms on tax filings, reviews, and audits
  • Support state and federal reporting requirements as applicable
  • Assist with insurance, sales tax, and other compliance areas

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Manage and develop accounting staff or external resources as the business grows
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain to provide financial insights
  • Deliver clear financial analysis to support pricing, promotions, and customer strategy
  • Act as a trusted financial thought partner to the CEO and leadership team

What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • CPA preferred but not required
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience
  • Experience in CPG, food and beverage, manufacturing, or inventory-heavy businesses strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of inventory accounting, costing, and margin analysis
  • Hands-on experience with QuickBooks and ERP systems
  • Katana experience is a strong plus
  • Proven ability to build and scale processes in a growing or entrepreneurial environment
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer

Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.

✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

title: Technical Support & Implementation Specialist
description:

They offer decades of proven expertise, having worked with large shippers, leading Silicon Valley companies, and top-tier consulting firms, to deliver reliable, high-performance services while lowering your total operating costs.Their deep understanding of operational challenges from multiple perspectives, along with their commitment to operational excellence, sustainability, and the implementation of cutting-edge technology, make our client the go-to partner for enterprises seeking world-class yard logistics solutions.

  • Handle a variety of issues that may arise during implementation and ongoing product use - always be ready to think on your feet!
  • Deliver excellent customer experiences

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 3 to 5 years of implementation or technical customer support experience in a software-as-a-service (SaaS) or software company
  • Experience with ticketing systems such as Zendesk and Hubspot (Hubspot preferred)
  • Ability to accurately describe issues, collect applicable documentation, and operate as a liaison between the product team and the customer

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, technical engineering, or Information Technology

  • Familiarity with the yard management industry
  • Awareness of logistics and supply chain management

  • When you know your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people

  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Snowflake Architect
description:
Job Title: Snowflake Architect

Location: Brazil (remote)

Contract Length: 6 months

CloudHive is your North America and LATAM Snowflake-focused staffing partner. We help accelerate Snowflake adoption and maximize the value of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud by delivering experienced, on-demand Snowflake contractors and specialized talent acquisition services.

We are seeking an experienced Snowflake Architect for a 6-month contract supporting a key client's data migration project. You'll design and implement scalable architectures to migrate legacy systems to Snowflake, ensuring seamless data pipelines, optimization, and security.

  • Architect and lead Snowflake migration, including schema design, ETL processes, and integration with tools like dbt, Fivetran, or Matillion.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define migration strategies, handle data quality checks, and implement governance best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards (e.g., role-based access control) during the migration.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Snowflake Architect or similar role, with proven expertise in large-scale data migrations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Snowflake SQL, Snowpark, and integration with cloud platforms (AWS).
  • Hands-on experience with data modeling, warehousing, and tools like dbt
  • Snowflake certification (e.g., SnowPro Core/Advanced Architect) preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills for stakeholder collaboration.

Please get in touch for more information. Strictly no third parties.

title: Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager
description:
Nós, da Knewin , somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2000 clientes , nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.

Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager para atuar como guardiã da experiência de nossos clientes, garantindo impacto real nos resultados e expansão sustentável da carteira. Você será responsável por conduzir relacionamentos estratégicos, conectar problemas de negócio às soluções da Knewin e atuar como principal voz do cliente internamente.

É uma posição que combina visão analítica, capacidade consultiva e uma execução disciplinada — sustentada por relações de confiança, foco em metas e busca contínua por excelência.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir uma carteira de clientes estratégicos, garantindo retenção, expansão e geração de valor contínuo;
  • Construir e conduzir planos de sucesso (Success Plans) com metas claras, indicadores e rituais de acompanhamento;
  • Atuar proativamente para prevenir churn com base em dados, comportamento de uso e sinais de risco.

  • Ser a principal referência do cliente dentro da Knewin, traduzindo necessidades em soluções;
  • Facilitar a adoção de produtos e orientar sobre melhores práticas;
  • Conduzir rituais executivos (QBRs/EBRs), apresentando resultados e roadmap de evolução.

  • Acompanhar métricas-chave como NRR, GRR, churn, engajamento e Earned Growth (NPS+);
  • Registrar interações, status e oportunidades no CRM com precisão e disciplina;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Produtos, Suporte, Dados e Comercial para resolução de problemas, ativação de melhorias e identificação de oportunidades.

  • Capacidade de realizar gestão de carteira com organização, priorização e disciplina;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e orientada a solução;

  • Vivência com ferramentas como CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), planilhas e plataformas de suporte;

  • Vivência em análise de dados ou uso de dashboards;
  • Experiência em atendimento a clientes enterprise/governo/corporativo;
  • Conhecimento em NPS, Customer Journey e metodologias de CS (ex.: WbD, Success Playbooks).

Diferenciais

  • Familiaridade com metodologias de consultoria (McKinsey, Bain, BCG);
  • Experiência com processos de expansão e cross-sell;
  • Histórico de alta performance em ambientes com metas arrojadas;
  • Participação na construção de processos, playbooks ou CS Ops;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de transformação e crescimento acelerado.

description:

Part Time ( 4 hours per day)

Solution Design & Architecture

  • Design robust, scalable architectures using our core technology stack:
  • Backend: PHP/Laravel, Node.js (MERN stack), Python

  • Hands on experience of using AI tools for bringing quality and efficiency in the in-house work

AI & Intelligent Systems

  • Architect and integrate AI-driven features such as chatbots, recommendation engines, predictive analytics, document processing, and intelligent search
  • Design solutions using machine learning and generative AI models, including LLM-based workflows
  • Experience integrating AI APIs and frameworks (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS AI services, Hugging Face)

Handover & Delivery Enablement

  • Solution architecture diagrams and user flow documentation
  • Finalized technology stack and infrastructure approach
  • Detailed functional and non-functional requirements
  • Integration points, API specifications, and external dependencies
  • Risk register, assumptions log, and edge case documentation

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, or Senior Software Engineer with direct client exposure
  • Deep hands-on experience with Laravel, MERN stack, React, Next.js, Flutter, React Native, and AWS
  • Proven track record designing web, mobile, and CMS-based solutions for international clients
  • Strong understanding of REST/GraphQL APIs, authentication patterns, and cloud-native architectures
  • Commercial acumen—ability to balance technical ideals with budget constraints, timelines, and business goals
  • Exceptional communication skills: you can explain technical concepts to C-suite executives and developer teams alike
  • Strong documentation skills and attention to detail
  • Strong training and mentoring skills for upskilling

Nice to Have

  • Experience with microservices, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), or serverless architectures
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code
  • Knowledge of GDPR, CCPA, or other regional compliance frameworks
  • Experience with real-time applications, AI/ML integrations, or IoT solutions
  • Previous consulting or agency experience serving diverse industries

Working Arrangement

  • Flexible, on-demand engagement tied to our sales pipeline and project needs
  • Primarily involved during pre-sales, discovery, and handover phases —not full-time project delivery
  • Hourly compensation with clear scoping for each engagement
  • Availability for client calls across multiple time zones (North America, UAE, GCC, Europe)
  • Remote-first with potential for occasional client meetings or workshops

Why This Role Matters

Your architectural decisions shape project success before a single line of code is written. You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy, and engineering—ensuring clients get solutions that not only meet their needs but exceed expectations. If you thrive on variety, love solving complex technical challenges, and want your expertise to directly impact business outcomes, this role is for you.

description:

  • Eagerness to learn and make a meaningful contribution.
  • Excitement to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance.
  • Fluent english is required.

title: Azure Windows Solutions Architect
description:
Lead Azure & Windows Infrastructure Architect (POD 1 & 2)

Location: Remote / Hybrid | Experience: 13+ Years | Level: C5/C6 (Senior Leadership)

The Challenge

Are you a master of Windows ecosystems ready to lead the charge into the Cloud? We are looking for a Lead Infrastructure Architect to spearhead large-scale migrations for high-stakes industries like Banking, Healthcare, and Insurance.

In this role, you aren’t just a designer—you are the General of our Cloud PODs. You will lead a technical team of 5+ engineers, ensuring that complex legacy environments are modernized, secured, and migrated to Azure with surgical precision.

Your Impact

  • Architectural Sovereignty: Design the end-to-end "Target State" for massive enterprise environments. You will own the HLD (High-Level Design) and LLD (Low-Level Design) , ensuring every VM, Cluster, and Network packet has its place.
  • Lead the Squad: Act as the technical North Star for a team of 5+ infra experts. You will guide, govern, and mentor your team to deliver excellence under pressure.
  • Windows Modernization: You are the expert who knows Windows Clustering, DFS, and File/Print Services inside out. You’ll be the one to solve the "impossible" legacy issues during migration.
  • The Business Brain: You don't just build; you justify. You’ll use TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and ROI metrics to prove to stakeholders that your architecture is the most efficient and cost-effective solution.
  • Mission Critical Support: You will oversee the stability of the environment, ensuring 24/7 reliability through robust Backup, DR, and Monitoring solutions.

What You Bring to the Table

  • The Veteran Background: 13+ years in IT with a deep focus on Windows Server and Azure IaaS/PaaS .
  • Migration Mastery: Expert-level experience with Azure Migrate for server consolidation and workload shifts.
  • Networking & Identity Guru: Deep knowledge of DNS, DHCP, WINS, and Azure IAM/Key Vault to keep our Landing Zones secure and connected.
  • Resilience Expert: Hands-on experience with Windows Clustering and Azure Site Recovery (ASR) for business continuity.
  • Strategic Communicator: You can navigate a 24x7 shift environment, manage customer calls with poise, and present complex solutions to C-suite stakeholders.

The Toolkit

  • Core: Azure Infrastructure, Windows Server (all versions), Azure Networking.
  • Leadership: Team Management & Technical Governance.
  • Compliance: Experience in regulated domains (SIAM, Data Privacy, Financial regulations).
  • Certifications (Preferred): AZ-305 (Solutions Architect Expert) or AZ-104 .

Why This Role?

This is more than a migration job; it’s a leadership opportunity. You will own the strategy for POD 1 and 2 , deciding how global enterprises evolve. If you enjoy solving complex "under-the-hood" Windows issues while simultaneously designing high-level cloud strategies, this is your next career move.

Ready to lead the migration? Apply now and let’s build the future of Enterprise Cloud.

What makes this version effective?

  1. Directly addresses the "POD" structure: It makes the candidate feel like they are leading a specific mission.
  2. Highlights the Hybrid nature: It acknowledges that they need to be good at both the new (Azure) and the old (Windows Clustering/DFS).
  3. Emphasizes Leadership: By using words like "General" and "North Star," you attract people who want to manage teams, not just configurations.

title: Senior Training Facilitator
description:
Position: Senior Training Facilitator

Sector: Corporate Training – Service, Sales, Core job & interpersonal skills

Company: Global Partners Training, Cambridge, MA

Work Location: Global On-Site/Virtual

Position Overview:

This is an ideal role for a mid-late career executive who believes passionately in the power of relationships, not just to drive business results, but also to make the world a better place.

GPT has active relationships and is chasing multi-year deals with large multinationals for training services in a wide array of countries in EMEA, APAC and the Americas. The company is seeking to expand its training capacity by locating qualified facilitators, to whom the company will provide complete training and onboarding.

This is a part-time project-driven role, and availability for GPT work with reasonable advance notice of facilitation opportunities is required. This is a non-salaried position, and so the candidate should have an entrepreneurial mindset and background. Once a facilitation project is identified, the candidate must plan initially to spend several hours, sometimes a few days, to engage with the onboarding & train-the-trainer process. While there is no cash cost for candidate to engage (GPT invests in the onboarding & train-the-trainer process), candidate must have the financial capacity that allows time for onboarding before facilitation work can ramp to provide income.

Candidate will ideally have a mature background culminating as a senior manager/executive in service operations, sales, project management or learning and development in a B2B environment. Former training facilitation experience is desirable but is not required. Experience with professional coaching is a plus. Candidate should be very comfortable leading highly interactive sessions in both face-to-face and virtual formats. Candidate will need to demonstrate a clear understanding of the application of training to business objectives, combined with the persistence and patience to maintain communications with trainees and bring out the best in each person. Candidate will also have strong references attesting attention to detail, imperative for executing multi-event training logistics.

Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of learning GPT program(s) fully and fluently, including watching videos, practicing solo, doing training dry-runs, responding positively to feedback, learning required technical aspects, executing required logistics, and keeping up with updates.
  • Adhere to GPT policies regarding facilitation work, including timely logistics requirements and data security, as stated in the contract as well as on the company’s internal website.
  • Support training groups, managers, sponsors and trainees in such a manner as to maintain every client as a referenceable account.
  • Professionally introduce and represent the company to prospects, clients and partners. (optional)
  • Provide regular and meaningful insights to GPT regarding training observations, new sales opportunities and potential competition.
  • Support GPT peers in developing a culture of empathy, customer focus, team spirit and fun that values mutual success and the highest standards of professionalism.
  • Balance assertiveness with being an excellent team player.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years in relevant senior management role(s) that gives insight into industry, corporate training and prospective trainees.
  • Strong understanding of the application of corporate training to achieve business results.
  • Desired track record of facilitation in face-to-face and virtual formats or the ability to learn quickly.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the customer: Technical, L&D, Financial and Executive.
  • Strong ability to facilitate training programs in English and the working local language(s) in your region.
  • Comfortable using technical systems, such as video-conferencing software, digital collaboration platforms, face-to-face systems such as laptop/projector interface, as well as CRM, LMS and other company information systems.
  • Exceptional empathy, interpersonal, writing and presentation skills.
  • Proactivity and thriving in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Autonomy and ability to get the job done without being prompted while managing local engagements.
  • Balancing ambition and drive with a high level of integrity.
  • Fun to be around, personable!

Compensation includes facilitation fees and opportunities for quality bonuses, as well as longer-term opportunities if interested for sales commissions and new client bonuses.

About Global Partners Training:

Global Partners Training (GPT) is a private, fast-growing provider of outsourced training programs to some of the largest global service companies in the high technology, health care, telecommunications, energy and industrial sectors. Regardless of the practical training topic, GPT’s wide array of proprietary training modules and programs deliver exceptional business results by targeting more productive interpersonal relationships among external and internal stakeholders across the workforce (field service, global shared services, sales, product, project, executive), and training effectiveness is demonstrated through an innovative process called Validated Behavior Change.

title: Estágio ADM
description:
Faça parte da ICL:

Na ICL, acreditamos que a inovação começa com pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem. Somos uma empresa global de soluções em especialidades, com presença em mais de 30 países e impacto em setores essenciais como agricultura, alimentos e materiais industriais.

Como líder mundial na fabricação de fertilizantes de eficiência aprimorada, oferecemos aos agricultores e à indústria soluções avançadas para uma agricultura de alto desempenho, incluindo produtos especiais de alta qualidade para diferentes necessidades. Nosso trabalho contribui para aumentar a produtividade, a rentabilidade e a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

No Brasil, nossa trajetória é marcada por crescimento sustentável, compromisso com a inovação e respeito às comunidades onde atuamos. Com unidades em diversas regiões do país, temos orgulho de impulsionar o desenvolvimento da agricultura brasileira, promovendo práticas mais eficientes e sustentáveis.

Objetivo do Cargo

Apoiar as rotinas administrativas da área, garantindo organização, controle e fluidez nos processos de compras, orçamentos, pagamentos e documentação, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional e o cumprimento das políticas internas da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar, conferir e acompanhar pedidos de compra e de serviços no sistema, assegurando a correta inserção das informações.
  • Elaborar, acompanhar e controlar orçamentos, garantindo alinhamento com centros de custo e políticas internas.
  • Solicitar cotações e apoiar processos de negociação com fornecedores, sob orientação da área responsável.
  • Realizar o lançamento, conferência e controle de notas fiscais (NF) no sistema.
  • Acompanhar o fluxo de aprovação de pedidos, contratos e pagamentos, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Atuar em interface com as áreas de Compras, Financeiro e Fiscal, apoiando o correto processamento das demandas.
  • Controlar prazos, vencimentos e status de pedidos, contratos e pagamentos.
  • Organizar, arquivar e manter atualizada a documentação fiscal e administrativa.
  • Apoiar as rotinas da área de frotas, incluindo solicitação e envio de cartões de abastecimento.
  • Prestar atendimento e suporte às áreas internas, esclarecendo dúvidas e apoiando demandas administrativas do dia a dia.
  • Apoiar a melhoria contínua dos processos administrativos, sugerindo ajustes e boas práticas quando necessário.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Cursando ensino superior em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Gestão Empresarial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento básico do Pacote Office (Excel, Word e Outlook).
  • Vivência ou conhecimento em sistemas integrados de gestão (ERP).
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com SAP será considerada um diferencial.

Na ICL, acreditamos que a diversidade é o motor da inovação. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para as pessoas independentemente de raça, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual ou qualquer outra característica. Embora esta posição não seja afirmativa/exclusiva, reforçamos que todas as pessoas são bem-vindas a se candidatar. Valorizamos diferentes perspectivas e experiências e ficaremos felizes em receber sua candidatura!

title: Designer
description:
Senior Freelance Designer (Contract)

Location: USA / Canada / LATAM

Type: Contract / Freelance

Experience: 8–15 years

About the Role

Our client is a forward-thinking NYC-based design agency working with a diverse portfolio of brands across multiple industries. They are looking to collaborate with a Senior Freelance Designer to support ongoing client projects, primarily focused on web, visual, and digital design .

This role is ideal for a senior, hands-on designer who is comfortable working in client-facing, agency-style environments , managing multiple projects, and delivering high-quality design solutions from concept to execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and other designers, to deliver effective design solutions aligned with client goals.
  • Lead visual and web design efforts across websites, landing pages, microsites, and digital brand assets.
  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and prototypes using tools such as Figma or Sketch.
  • Develop and maintain visual systems, style guides, and brand consistency across digital and print materials.
  • Design marketing assets including presentations, social media visuals, email assets, and campaign materials.
  • Ensure designs are optimized for both desktop and mobile experiences, following UI/UX best practices.
  • Participate in client reviews and presentations, clearly communicating design concepts and rationale.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure accurate design handoff and implementation.

Required Qualifications

  • 8–15 years of professional experience in Web Design, Visual Design, and/or Graphic Design .
  • Strong portfolio showcasing a range of digital, web, and visual design projects (portfolio required).
  • Advanced proficiency with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
  • Solid understanding of UI/UX principles , responsive design, and usability best practices.
  • Experience working in agency or client-facing environments .
  • Ability to work independently as a freelancer or contractor, managing priorities and timelines effectively.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort presenting work to clients and stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience working with U.S.-based clients or international teams.
  • Background in branding and design systems.
  • Experience mentoring or providing guidance to junior designers.
  • Familiarity with motion, interaction design, or basic front-end concepts (HTML/CSS) is a plus.

Engagement Details

  • Contract / Freelance role
  • Flexible hours, based on project needs
  • Fully remote
  • Hourly compensation, based on experience and availability

A G Mining Services é uma empresa multidisciplinar que oferece serviços profissionais no setor de mineração, para projetos de mineração subterrânea e a céu aberto, em metais preciosos, básicos ou industriais. Engenheiro/a de mineração, Mina a céu aberto

Sob a supervisão do Coordenador de Mineração de Superfície do departamento de engenharia de mineração, o titular do cargo estará envolvido em todas as fases de avaliação e desenvolvimento de projetos de mineração a céu aberto locais e internacionais.   • Fornecer orientações e aconselhamento técnico a outros membros do departamento e da empresa.

  • Muito bom conhecimento de softwares especializados, como Autocad, Deswilk e Gemcom.
  • Facilidade com o Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Habilidades desejadas

  • Vontade de aprender e melhorar.
  • Excelente compreensão dos procedimentos de aquisição, direito de licitações, direito contratuais, seguros, cauções e obrigações.
  • Capacidade de negociar o melhor preço com fornecedores e resolver questões contratuais no site.
  • Forte capacidade de liderança, gestão de equipes e habilidades de comunicação no contexto de gestão de projetos.
  • Atenção ao detalhe e rigor no monitoramento e execução dos contratos.
  • Adaptabilidade a um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e capacidade de gerenciar várias prioridades simultaneamente.
